content.title: American Airlines Reports Earnings Tuesday. What the Stock Needs to Fly Through the Storm.
content.summary: Wall Street is watching to see if  American Airlines  can beat expectations when the carrier reports its earnings before the open Tuesday.  Another aviation giant,  United  beat fourth-quarter predictions last week, boosting the stock—investors will hope American can do the same.  Analysts are expecting adjusted earnings per share of 37 cents on revenue of $14 billion in the fourth quarter, according to FactSet data.

content.title: CEOs Flag Jittery US Consumers as Global Tensions Intensify
